get.summary: Read a verified Checkout receipt without an agent credential
get.description: Read-only receipt lookup. The opaque Stripe Checkout session ID grants access only to this purchase confirmation. No balance, agent identity or payment details are returned. A redirect flag alone never proves payment; agents still confirm their owned purchase and current balance before compute.

200.description: Verified receipt state, including delayed crediting and adjustments. creditedCents is the contribution of this purchase, not the current spendable wallet balance.

409.description: Receipt binding or payment state could not be verified

503.description: Receipt verification unavailable; retry the same receipt, not a new purchase

get.summary: Open an existing verified checkout through a short first-party link
get.description: Read-only lookup using the opaque Checkout session ID. Verifies the purchase binding, amount, currency and environment before redirecting to Stripe’s exact URL. Completed or expired sessions return to confirmation. Does not create sessions, charge a payment, or update the ledger. Treat this capability link as private.

303.description: Navigate to the existing Stripe checkout or its confirmation page.

409.description: Checkout binding or destination could not be verified

503.description: Checkout temporarily unavailable

post.summary: Reserve one managed Astra model job within a total USD cap

409.description: Conflicting request or insufficient available credit

201.description: Reserved job state. New workflow-version-3 jobs persist their version and resolved reference choice. Version 3 reserves 30 minutes at caps of at least 500 cents and ten minutes below that; legacy reservations are unchanged. chargedAiCents includes image generation and modeling; chargedReferenceCents is the image portion, not an additional charge. referenceReady exposes reference.jpg; a version-3 checkpoint exposes review.json. Model artifacts appear after a validated export; visuallyInspected identifies durable independent acceptance. Turnaround video is included when available.

referenceMode.description: generate requests one GPT Image 2.5 Flare four-view reference sheet. none explicitly opts out. For workflow version 3, omission resolves to generate only when managed.references.enabled is true and budgetCents is at least 500; otherwise it resolves to none. The resolved choice is persisted and reference generation stays inside the same total cap.

get.summary: Observe a private managed job and cost settlement

200.description: Job state including status, progress, chargedAiCents, pendingAiCents, computeChargedCents, computeStatus, visuallyInspected and available artifacts. videoReady confirms a returned turnaround.mp4: two seconds, 512 pixels, 12 fps, 360 degrees, within the same approved budget. Missing video due to budget or render deadline yields partial status with a reason and other available files.
